relationships.subject: Cannabinoids
relationships.evidence_quote: Cannabis and its constituents can modulate multiple cancer related pathways such as PKB, AMPK, CAMKK-β, mTOR, PDHK, HIF-1α, and PPAR-γ

relationships.subject: Cannabinoids
relationships.evidence_quote: Cannabinoids can block cell growth, progression of cell cycle and induce apoptosis selectively in tumour cells

key_findings: Review: cannabinoids show anticancer activity across multiple tumour types via ECS and signaling pathways including PPAR-gamma.
